expanded_name: Probe- and Assay-Calibrated Efficacy Ranker for Allosteric Coupling Mechanisms

scope.anchor_selection: ECFP4 medoid followed by deterministic max-min diversity; labels hidden during selection

representation.base_predictor: frozen cross-campaign ligand/structure predictor supplied before target labels
representation.calibration: endpoint-wise arithmetic mean of three anchor residuals

evaluation.success_rule: paired delta lower 95% CI > 0 versus every baseline, no worst-series degradation, and refusal coverage disclosed

claim_boundary: Computational functional-rank hypothesis only; neither confirmed PAM activity nor universal SOTA.
